x_1577958_dsb_pattern.name: Field Service Management
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.overview: Model the resources, then the work, then the experience. (1) Territories, skills, agent schedules and stockrooms (including van stock) loaded as reference data. (2) Work orders from CSM cases, ITSM incidents, assets and maintenance plans using OOB create actions. (3) Work order task templates by job type with required skills and parts. (4) Dispatcher Workspace with auto-assignment / Dynamic Scheduling where licensed; appointment booking windows. (5) Parts sourcing and consumption through OOB part requirements and transfer orders. (6) Now Mobile / FSM mobile app with offline, time, parts, signature and checklists. (7) Planned maintenance plans on assets. (8) Customer notifications and ETA. (9) KPIs: first-time fix, utilisation, travel, SLA.
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.pain: Manual dispatch; poor utilisation and travel time Low first-time fix because parts and history are missing No customer appointment windows or ETA Preventive maintenance tracked outside the system Technicians complete paper job sheets
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.summary: Field work is dispatched by phone and spreadsheet: technicians arrive without the right parts or history, first-visit resolution is low, and customers get no appointment certainty. The pattern converges on OOB Field Service Management: work orders and work order tasks from cases, incidents or planned maintenance; territories, skills and schedules; dispatcher workspace with (dynamic) scheduling; parts sourcing from stockrooms and van stock; the mobile agent app with offline capability; and customer appointment booking and notifications.
